sofia: FYI rolled kernel 6.6.4 + nvidia-driver 536.21 to us-west-2-gpu-canary around 1728364920. Seeing intermittent P2P disabled on some A100 hosts and BAR1 reported much smaller than expected. NCCL throughput dropped on a couple of jobs. dmesg snippet below:

sofia: ```[1728364921.123456] nvidia 0000:3b:00.0: BAR1 size requested 0x20000000, assigned 0x10000000
[1728364921.123789] nv_peer_mem: peer-to-peer disabled (ACS or BAR1 mismatch)
[1728364921.124000] nvidia: PCIe: device 3b:00.0 P2P disabled
```

kamal: How many nodes affected? Canary was 12 nodes right?

sofia: ~3 hosts show BAR1 shrinkage in host-level inventory, 2 hosts show P2P_off flag in nvidia-smi topo output. Rest look fine.

matt: Observed NCCL allreduce latency x3 on those hosts, training jobs degraded, autoscaler is spinning up extra pods -> cost spike on ephemeral CPUs while waiting.

jing: Any kernel cmdline tweaks? Did we flip `pci=nomsi` or `pci=realloc` accidentally in the image?

sofia: No cmdline changes in the AMI build; same boot args as previous release. I suspect driver/kernel combo (536.21 + 6.6.4) triggers a PCIe ACS or BAR negotiation regression on certain Ampere boards.

ryan: Rolling the driver back to 535.98 on the remaining canaries now to confirm. Initiating controlled rollback, will report back.

ops-bot: Deploy snapshot: rollback-driver-535.98 started for us-west-2-gpu-canary (initiated by ryan)

deploy-bot: 1728364978 - rollback-driver-535.98: 4/12 nodes completed, 2 nodes failed health probe (will retry)

kamal: If rollback fixes P2P, we should pause the larger rollout to eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. Also need a bisection ticket with vendor.

matt: Agree. Also patch the autoscaler to avoid scaling up CPU-only instances for GPU queue backlog until we confirm fix — cost is compounding.

jing: Quick check you can run on an affected host: `sudo cat /sys/bus/pci/devices/0000:3b:00.0/resource` and `nvidia-smi topo --matrix` — compare to healthy host.

sofia: Adding outputs to the incident ticket. Will capture `lspci -vvv` and `dmesg` for the 3 affected hosts and open a case with Nvidia (include hardware lot & BIOS versions).

ryan: Update: after rollback to 535.98 on the 4 completed nodes, P2P came back and BAR1 size restored to expected value. Holding the rest of the fleet rollout.

matt: Action items: 1) pause rollout, 2) run bisection (535.98 -> 536.21) on repro host, 3) patch autoscaler behavior, 4) open vendor escalations + include kernel config.

sofia: I'll create the bisection playbook and assign. Tagging @nvidia-support once we have the lspci/dmesg bundle.

kamal: For visibility, create a short Slack post to #incidents and ping infra-oncall. We need to track cost delta in parallel.

sofia: Will do. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
